description: This file defines constants, data categories, format names, and classes related to datev CSV data handling, including column definitions for transactions, debtors/creditors, and account names.

classes.name: DataCategory
classes.description: Defines CSV header field categories with string identifiers.

classes.name: FormatName
classes.description: Maps data categories to human-readable format names.

classes.name: Transactions
classes.description: Encapsulates transaction column definitions and related metadata.

classes.name: DebtorsCreditors
classes.description: Encapsulates debtor/creditor column definitions and related metadata.

classes.name: AccountNames
classes.description: Encapsulates account name column definitions and related metadata.
